Summary

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts(WH0.39%)emphasized record net room growth, reaching its highest ever organic room additions and a materially expanded development pipeline. Management reported robust international expansion, accelerating franchisee signings, and stated that their cost discipline allowed EBITDA and EPS to grow despite industry-wide declines in RevPAR. The company outlined new technology initiatives, scaling AI for booking and labor efficiency, and highlighted new strategic partnerships and loyalty gains. Management detailed the financial and outlook impact of the Revo insolvency, explicitly removing all related revenues from 2026 expectations until collection certainty is achieved.
